column3: ESTABLISHMENT OF THE OCEAN UNIVERSITY OF SRI LANKA.
(1) Notwithstanding anything to the contrary in the

column2: Universities Act, No. 16 of 1978, there shall be established a
University  called  the  Ocean  University  of  Sri  Lanka
( hereinafter in this Act referred to as “ the University”).

column3: (2)  The  University  shall  be  a  body  corporate  with

column2: perpetual  succession  and,  by  the  name  assigned  to  it  by
subsection (1), may sue and be sued.
